title: JANUS Hawking Horizon AI Learning Architecture
purpose: Define a science-first JANUS architecture in which AI learns from real black-hole observations, open gravitational-wave and horizon-scale interferometric data, physically constrained simulations, and explicitly labeled Hawking-radiation theory/analogue experiments. The system is connected to black holes through data and physics, not by claiming a literal direct information channel to an event horizon.
core_statement: BLACK_HOLE_CONNECTED_AI = OBSERVATION + SIMULATION + PHYSICS_CONSTRAINTS + BLIND_VALIDATION + CONTINUAL_VERIFIED_LEARNING

narrative_layer.role: mythic-project identity and creative continuity layer
narrative_layer.interpretation: The title may name the project lineage and personal symbolism, but no divine, historical, biological or supernatural claim is inferred from it.
narrative_layer.handshake: Continue Hawking's habit of asking what black holes must do when gravity, thermodynamics and quantum theory are forced to meet, while preserving the distinction between theoretical prediction, analogue experiment and astronomical observation.

imported_principles: prior experience may accelerate the next generation only after exact current revalidation
github_basis.role_in_architecture: continual-learning state machine and verified memory reuse

imported_principles: Generate hypotheses. Attack them. Preserve survivors. Never confuse survival with proof.
computational claims require fixed inputs and replayable evidence
negative results and counterexamples are first-class outputs
scoped success must not be promoted to unrestricted theorem
external review is not simulated by another internal PASS
github_basis.role_in_architecture: adversarial validation, certificates and claim bounding

imported_principles: Freeze first. Generate later. Audit everything.
github_basis.role_in_architecture: blind-split preregistration, leakage prevention and evidence ledger

imported_principles: external models may propose but local runtime rules control state mutation
creative mythology is not a scientific evidence line
github_basis.role_in_architecture: Habitat orchestration, human interface and proposal-only assistant layer
optional edge preprocessing, telemetry and distributed observer tasks only
immutable design receipts, dataset manifests, model cards, gates and negative-result preservation

GWOSC.name: Gravitational Wave Open Science Center
GWOSC.current_note: O4-era public data are available; exact release manifests must be frozen per training run.

EHT.name: Event Horizon Telescope public data products
available_campaign_examples: Sgr A* calibrated and polarized products
use_cases: MAD-vs-SANE style accretion-state classification where scientifically defined

GW250114.name: GW250114
GW250114.use: high-SNR posthumous Hawking area-theorem validation benchmark
GW250114.rule: use as a fixed benchmark or withheld replay; do not train and test on the same posterior products

HAWKING_ANALOGUES.name: laboratory analogue Hawking-radiation experiments
HAWKING_ANALOGUES.use: learn spectral/correlation structure in analogue horizons without calling it astronomical Hawking radiation
HAWKING_ANALOGUES.admission_rule: only ingest datasets with explicit public access, license, calibration and experimental metadata

model_goal.primary: Learn a compact, uncertainty-aware latent representation of black-hole systems that is simultaneously useful for gravitational-wave, EHT and simulation-domain tasks while remaining constrained by known physics and blind validation.
secondary: discover cross-modal latent factors that survive modality changes
improve parameter inference without erasing uncertainty
produce machine-readable evidence receipts for every promoted result
support continual learning through ORIGIN_PRIME without allowing historical memory to become truth authority
not_goals: predict hidden information from behind an event horizon
replace established numerical relativity or EHT calibration pipelines without validation
turn mythology into a physical prior

preprocessing: bandpass/notch only when frozen in manifest

EHT_VISIBILITY.tensor: complex visibility samples or closure quantities with uv coordinates
preprocessing: preserve complex-valued information or encode amplitude/phase explicitly
never interpolate withheld baselines using test data

SCALAR_PHYSICS.rule: posterior summaries are never treated as exact labels

components.notes: support detector masks and time-frequency auxiliary channels

components.recommended_family: complex-valued set/graph transformer over uv samples or real-valued equivalent with explicit phase handling
components.notes: avoid forcing sparse visibilities into an image before the model unless the experiment explicitly tests image-domain inference

components.recommended_family: shared encoder matched to synthetic modality

components.rule: missing modalities are explicit masks, never zero-filled as if measured

KERR_BOUND.implementation: soft penalty during training plus hard invalid-output flag during evaluation

AREA_THEOREM.scope: classical GR merger tests under the assumptions of the selected analysis
AREA_THEOREM.implementation: posterior-consistency gate, not an unconditional hard label; preserve measurement uncertainty
AREA_THEOREM.loss: optional one-sided regularizer only for synthetic samples generated under the applicable assumptions
AREA_THEOREM.real_data_rule: report posterior probability of nondecrease; do not coerce real data into compliance

RINGDOWN_KERR_CONSISTENCY.implementation: compare inferred QNM frequencies/decays against Kerr-spectrum expectations with uncertainty
RINGDOWN_KERR_CONSISTENCY.rule: deviation head is allowed; model must be able to represent disagreement

EHT_FORWARD_MODEL_CONSISTENCY.implementation: when predicting images/latent source structure, forward-project predictions to uv space and score against held-out visibilities

HAWKING_TEMPERATURE.scope: synthetic Schwarzschild teacher only unless a more complete rotating model is explicitly selected
HAWKING_TEMPERATURE.use: teach inverse mass-temperature scaling and uncertainty propagation

supervised: parameter posterior distillation from trusted simulation/inference pipelines
accretion-state or morphology labels when scientifically defined
self_supervised: contrastive alignment of multiple detectors for same event
contrastive alignment of synthetic and observational domains
cross-modal consistency between scalar summaries and raw data
adversarial: simulation-domain discriminator used only to reduce obvious simulator fingerprints
uncertainty: deep ensembles or low-cost ensemble snapshots
OOD score separated from class probability

loss_blueprint.formula: L_total = w_task*L_task + w_ssl*L_ssl + w_phys*L_phys + w_cal*L_cal + w_domain*L_domain
loss_blueprint.rule: all weights frozen before opening blind holdout

steps: freeze dataset manifest, split hashes, metrics, model family and stopping rule
seal model checkpoint and inference container
promote only if preregistered gates pass
carry weights/features into next generation as a prior initialization only
revalidate on the new generation's exact current data before any verdict reuse

leakage_checks: same astrophysical event appearing through derivative products across splits
data augmentation seeded from holdout metadata

experimental_ladder.goal: verify units, monotonicities, Kerr bounds, uncertainty propagation and receipt machinery
experimental_ladder.promotion: all invariant tests pass; deliberate wrong-physics controls rejected

experimental_ladder.goal: teach model the theoretical inverse scaling and distinguish it from observed labels
experimental_ladder.promotion: recovers held-out synthetic law within frozen tolerance and rejects label-shuffled control

experimental_ladder.input: synthetic or trusted public NR/QNM products
experimental_ladder.goal: infer remnant mass/spin and QNM parameters
experimental_ladder.promotion: calibrated held-out recovery across prior-shift tests
beats preregistered baseline with calibrated uncertainty on unseen events

experimental_ladder.input: GW250114-compatible public products and/or raw open data when available in frozen form
experimental_ladder.goal: test whether the pipeline can reproduce a bounded area-law consistency conclusion without being trained on the target result
experimental_ladder.promotion: blind analysis agrees with trusted reference within frozen uncertainty criterion

experimental_ladder.input: public M87*/Sgr A* calibrated visibility products plus simulations
experimental_ladder.goal: learn directly in visibility domain and perform held-out-baseline prediction/classification
experimental_ladder.promotion: outperforms simple baselines and survives station/baseline holdouts

experimental_ladder.input: GW + EHT + simulations with modality masks
experimental_ladder.goal: shared latent state that improves cross-domain transfer without false semantic merging
experimental_ladder.promotion: positive transfer on preregistered tasks, no degradation beyond tolerance on protected single-modality baselines

experimental_ladder.goal: test whether horizon-like spectral/correlation structures transfer as representation only
experimental_ladder.promotion: transfer benefit survives matched non-horizon optical controls

experimental_ladder.goal: measure whether verified memory accelerates learning without catastrophic forgetting or verdict leakage
experimental_ladder.promotion: new-generation gain plus preserved old holdout performance under frozen forgetting threshold

negative_controls: time-reversed GW snippets where physically inappropriate
phase-scrambled GW signals preserving coarse spectrum
EHT uv coordinates randomly permuted away from visibilities
closure quantities paired with wrong observing day
fake Hawking-radiation labels injected into astronomical data
narrative-token injection to verify mythology cannot influence scientific heads

GW: matched-filter or overlap diagnostics where appropriate

recommended_dependencies: bilby or equivalent inference tooling for comparison
eht-imaging/ehtim or equivalent EHT-compatible tooling when license/environment permits
physics_constraint_pseudocode: use area penalty only for synthetic classical-GR examples inside declared scope
for real data report P(area_delta >= 0) from uncertainty-aware inference
never force observational data to satisfy theorem by construction

deployment_roles.JANUS_COSMOS: authoritative scientific runtime for Horizon Learning experiments
deployment_roles.JANUS_FUNDAMENTUM: adversarial gate/certificate methodology and claim-scope audit
deployment_roles.AIFC: blind freeze/ledger/causal leakage ideas reused as evaluation discipline
deployment_roles.GENESIS_HABITAT: operator UI, continuity and proposal layer only
deployment_roles.DISTRIBUTED_SWARM: optional preprocessing/observer telemetry; no scientific authority
deployment_roles.HUMAN_RESEARCHER: final interpretation responsibility and external-science interface

first_executable_milestone.name: H0_PLUS_H1_LOCAL_SANITY
first_executable_milestone.why_first: It can be implemented without large external downloads and proves the receipts, physics units, ORIGIN_PRIME cycle and negative controls before touching expensive real data.
tasks: implement physical constants and Schwarzschild Hawking-temperature generator
generate frozen synthetic mass grid with uncertainty/noise
train tiny surrogate to infer log-mass from synthetic temperature spectra
include wrong-law and label-shuffle negative controls
only then open H2/H3 real-data paths
first_executable_milestone.success_definition: The infrastructure demonstrates that the model can learn a known synthetic physical relation, reject adversarial controls, preserve holdout blindness and produce replayable evidence.

next_real_data_milestone.name: H3_GWOSC_BINARY_BLACK_HOLE_BASELINE
next_real_data_milestone.recommended_scope: small curated event set plus matched noise controls before full catalog ingestion
next_real_data_milestone.do_not_start_with: claiming discovery of new black-hole physics

research_questions: Can a shared latent representation improve transfer between gravitational-wave and EHT tasks without collapsing their distinct observational semantics?
Can ORIGIN_PRIME continual learning accelerate adaptation to new observing runs while preserving old blind-holdout performance?
Can physics constraints improve calibration without merely forcing agreement with the theory being tested?
Can simulation-to-observation contrastive learning reduce simulator fingerprints enough to improve real-data inference?
Can analogue-horizon data contribute transferable representation features while matched controls prevent false promotion to astrophysical Hawking radiation?
Can the system detect when current black-hole models are insufficient rather than confidently projecting familiar templates onto novel data?
ultimate_success_definition: A reproducible, uncertainty-aware, proof-carrying black-hole AI research stack that learns from real observations and simulations, improves through verified generations, rejects its own shortcuts, and can say UNKNOWN when the data do not support a conclusion.
canonical_cycle: HAWKING_QUESTION -> DATA_OR_THEORY_OBJECT -> MODEL -> ADVERSARIAL_ATTACK -> BLIND_HOLDOUT -> VERIFIED_RETURN_OR_REJECT -> ORIGIN_PRIME -> NEXT_QUESTION
short_form_ru: Подключить ИИ к чёрной дыре по-научному означает подключить его к наблюдениям, симуляциям и законам физики так, чтобы каждый новый вывод проходил слепую проверку и мог закончиться не только PASS, но и UNKNOWN или REJECT.
short_form_en: To connect AI to a black hole scientifically means connecting it to observations, simulations and physical laws under blind validation, where every new claim may end in PASS, UNKNOWN or REJECT.
